call_1_requirements.text: {"requirements":[{"paragraph":"6.1.1","text":"A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation."},{"paragraph":"6.1.1.1","text":"A vehicle shall be tested for radiated emissions and for immunity to radiated disturbances."},{"paragraph":"6.1.1.1","text":"No tests for conducted emissions or immunity to conducted disturbances are required for vehicle type approval."},{"paragraph":"6.1.1.2","text":"ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances."},{"paragraph":"6.1.2","text":"Before testing, the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions."},{"paragraph":"6.1.2","text":"Depending on the intended operating conditions of the propulsion system, the test plan shall define the minimum number of steady state operating conditions of the vehicle, selectable by the driver or by the control system."},{"paragraph":"6.1.2","text":"The test conditions shall consider multiple propulsion system operating strategies which can be activated permanently by the driver or the vehicle control system and shall be based on documentation provided in Annexes 2A and 2B (e.g. risk analysis)."},{"paragraph":"6.2.1","text":"The electromagnetic radiation generated by the vehicle representative of its type shall be measured using the method described in Annex 4."},{"paragraph":"6.2.1","text":"The method of measurement shall be defined by the vehicle manufacturer in accordance with the Technical Service."},{"paragraph":"6.2.2.1","text":"If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 4 using a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the limits shall be 32 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 32 to 43 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 2 to this Regulation."},{"paragraph":"6.2.2.1","text":"In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 43 dB microvolts/m."},{"paragraph":"6.2.2.2","text":"If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 4 using a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 3.0 ± 0.05 m, the limits shall be 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 3 to this Regulation."},{"paragraph":"6.2.2.2","text":"In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m."},{"paragraph":"6.2.2.3","text":"On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits."},{"paragraph":"6.3.1","text":"The electromagnetic radiation generated by the vehicle representative of its type shall be measured using the method described in Annex 5."},{"paragraph":"6.3.1","text":"These shall be defined by the vehicle manufacturer in accordance with the Technical Service."},{"paragraph":"6.3.2.1","text":"If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 5 using a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the limits shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band."},{"paragraph":"6.3.2.2","text":"If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 5 using a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 3.0 ± 0.05 m, the limits shall be 38 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 45 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band."},{"paragraph":"6.3.2.3","text":"On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limit."},{"paragraph":"6.4.1","text":"The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the vehicle representative of its type shall be tested by the method described in Annex 6."},{"paragraph":"6.4.2.1","text":"If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, in accordance with ISO 11451-2, the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band."},{"paragraph":"6.4.2.1","text":"The field strength shall be 10 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 8 volts/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band."},{"paragraph":"6.4.2.1","text":"If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, in accordance with ISO 11451-4 BCI the current shall be 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band."},{"paragraph":"6.4.2.2","text":"The vehicle representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 6, there shall be no degradation of performance of \"immunity related functions\", according to paragraph 2.1. of Annex 6."},{"paragraph":"6.5.1","text":"The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7."},{"paragraph":"6.5.2.1","text":"If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation."},{"paragraph":"6.5.2.1","text":"In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m."},{"paragraph":"6.5.2.2","text":"On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits."},{"paragraph":"6.6.1","text":"The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8."},{"paragraph":"6.6.2.1","text":"If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7."},{"paragraph":"6.6.2.1","text":"In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m."},{"paragraph":"6.6.2.2","text":"On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits."},{"paragraph":"6.7.1","text":"The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1."},{"paragraph":"6.7.1. Table 1","text":"The maximum allowed pulse amplitude for vehicles with 12 V systems shall be +75 V for positive polarity and -100 V for negative polarity."},{"paragraph":"6.7.1. Table 1","text":"The maximum allowed pulse amplitude for vehicles with 24 V systems shall be +150 V for positive polarity and -450 V for negative polarity."},{"paragraph":"6.8.1","text":"The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9."},{"paragraph":"6.8.2.1","text":"The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a."},{"paragraph":"6.8.2.1","text":"Test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b."},{"paragraph":"6.8.2.1. Table 2a","text":"In over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band, the test level below 2 GHz shall be 60 V/m for Stripline (20 to 400 MHz), 75 V/m for TEM cell (20 to 200 MHz), 60 mA for BCI (20 to 400 MHz), 30 V/m for ALSE (80 to 2,000 MHz) and 21 V/m for Reverberation chamber (LUF to 2,000 MHz)."},{"paragraph":"6.8.2.1. Table 2a","text":"In over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band, the test level above 2 GHz shall be 10 V/m for ALSE (2,000 to 6,000 MHz) and 7 V/m for Reverberation chamber (2,000 to 6,000 MHz); Stripline, TEM cell and BCI are not applicable above 2 GHz."},{"paragraph":"6.8.2.1. Table 2b","text":"Over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band, the minimum test level below 2 GHz shall be 50 V/m for Stripline (20 to 400 MHz), 62,5 V/m for TEM cell (20 to 200 MHz), 50 mA for BCI (20 to 400 MHz), 25 V/m for ALSE (80 to 2,000 MHz) and 18 V/m for Reverberation chamber (LUF to 2,000 MHz)."},{"paragraph":"6.8.2.1. Table 2b","text":"Over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band, the minimum test level above 2 GHz shall be 8 V/m for ALSE (2,000 to 6,000 MHz) and 6 V/m for Reverberation chamber (2,000 to 6,000 MHz); Stripline, TEM cell and BCI are not applicable above 2 GHz."},{"paragraph":"6.8.2.2","text":"The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of \"immunity related functions\"."},{"paragraph":"6.9.1","text":"The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b."},{"paragraph":"6.9.1","text":"Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1."},{"paragraph":"6.9.1","text":"Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b."},{"paragraph":"6.9.1","text":"Starting profile is only applicable to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor."},{"paragraph":"6.9.1","text":"For the starting profile (Table 3a), the immunity test level shall be II for both 12 V and 24 V systems, 10 pulses shall be applied, the functional status classification shall be B for ESA related to immunity related functions and D for ESA not related to immunity related functions, with (for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases) C (for other ESA)."},{"paragraph":"6.9.1","text":"For test pulse 1 (Table 3b), the immunity test level shall be -75 V for 12V systems and -450 V for 24V systems, 500 pulses shall be applied, and the FPSC shall be III for ESA related to immunity related functions and III for ESA not related to immunity related functions."},{"paragraph":"6.9.1","text":"For test pulse 2a (Table 3b), the immunity test level shall be +37 V for 12V systems and +37 V for 24V systems, 500 pulses shall be applied, and the FPSC shall be I for ESA related to immunity related functions and III for ESA not related to immunity related functions."},{"paragraph":"6.9.1","text":"For test pulse 2b (Table 3b), the immunity test level shall be +10 V for 12V systems and +20 V for 24V systems, 10 pulses shall be applied, and the FPSC shall be II for ESA related to immunity related functions and III for ESA not related to immunity related functions."},{"paragraph":"6.9.1","text":"For test pulse 3a (Table 3b), the immunity test level shall be -112 V for 12V systems and -150 V for 24V systems, the test duration/number of pulses shall be 1 h, and the FPSC shall be I for ESA related to immunity related functions and III for ESA not related to immunity related functions."},{"paragraph":"6.9.1","text":"For test pulse 3b (Table 3b), the immunity test level shall be +75 V for 12V systems and +150 V for 24V systems, the test duration/number of pulses shall be 1 h, and the FPSC shall be I for ESA related to immunity related functions and III for ESA not related to immunity related functions."},{"paragraph":"6.10.1","text":"Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8."},{"paragraph":"6.10.2","text":"Vehicles which do not have electrical/electronic systems with \"immunity related functions\" need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.4. and with Annex 6 to this Regulation."},{"paragraph":"6.10.3","text":"ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation."},{"paragraph":"6.10.4","text":"For vehicles fitted with tyres, the vehicle body/chassis can be considered to be an electrically isolated structure; no type approval test for electrostatic discharge is deemed necessary."},{"paragraph":"6.10.5","text":"ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7."},{"paragraph":"6.10.6","text":"The loss of function of receivers during the immunity test, when the test signal is within the receiver bandwidth (RF exclusion band) as specified for the specific radio service/product in the harmonized international EMC standard, does not necessarily lead to fail criteria."},{"paragraph":"6.10.7","text":"RF transmitters shall be tested in the transmit mode."},{"paragraph":"6.10.7","text":"Wanted emissions (e.g. from RF transmitting systems) within the necessary bandwidth and out of band emissions are disregarded for the purpose of this Regulation."},{"paragraph":"6.10.7","text":"Spurious emissions are subject to this Regulation."},{"paragraph":"6.10.8","text":"For trolleybuses, the AC/DC mains portion of the vehicle propulsion system shall be excluded from this Regulation."}]}

call_2_changes.text: {"changes": [{"change": "added", "new_text": "For vehicles equipped with an ADS, in the case where the ADS cannot be fully activated or function normally within the EMC (laboratory) test environment, the manufacturer, in agreement with the Type Approval Authority, shall propose alternative methods and/or test configurations, to ensure the ADS is evaluated in a manner which is representative of its intended on-road operation and to demonstrate compliance with the provisions of this Regulation.", "new_paragraph": "6.11.3"}, {"change": "added", "new_text": "The methods used shall be subject to agreement by the Type Approval Authority and shall be recorded and described in the test report.", "new_paragraph": "6.11.3"}, {"change": "added", "new_text": "An alternative method using ESA immunity to external sources according to Annex 9, which may include the evaluation of multiple modules to enable a system-level test, does not require E-marking of the concerned ESA.", "new_paragraph": "6.11.3"}, {"change": "added", "new_text": "The same test method (vehicle type approval in combination with ESA test report for Annex 9) shall be applied during Conformity of Production test or any applicable test method according to this Annex.", "new_paragraph": "6.11.3"}]}
